card.name: Word starts inside split medical terms
card.fires_on: Responds to a short word-start piece such as int, S or s that begins a split word or abbreviation, as in SLE, SSc-ILD, intaking, intubated or sputum. It appears in drug-label text.

modes.label: Abbreviations starting with S
modes.description: The S piece that begins disease abbreviations like SLE and SSc-ILD.

modes.description: The int piece that begins words like intake or intubated.
modes.example: Both acute and chronic<< int>>akes result in toxicity

modes.label: Lowercase s in sputum
modes.description: The s piece that begins sputum in tuberculosis treatment text.
modes.example: if the patient is still<< s>>putum or culture positive
